Welcome to **Asymptotically Correct** — my long-form research notebook.

I use this site to collect:

- working notes on **singular learning theory (SLT)** and its thermodynamic view  
- experiments in **variational inference** (SIVI, structured VI, α-VB, etc.)  
- work on **fair learning**   
- applied and computational notes in **NLP / LLMs / RAG**  

All content on this site reflects ongoing research in draft form. No statement, proof, or claim should be interpreted as finalized, peer-reviewed, or guaranteed to be correct.

Intellectual ownership of the ideas remains fully with the author unless explicitly stated otherwise.
